info.name: The Mystery of the White Portion

descriptions.notStarted: #b#@1052001:##k in #bKerning City#k says he may be able to reveal the white portion of the #rDirty Treasure Map#k. Let's talk to him.
descriptions.inProgress: #b#@1052001:##k in #bKerning City#k has asked you to bring him #rInk#k (a drop item from #rOctopuses#k) in order to uncover the mystery of the Treasure Map. He says there is a hidden portal that will take you to a location filled with #rOctopuses#k near the yellow barricade in #b#m103010000##k.\n\nReport back to #b#@1052001:##k in #bKerning City#k upon completion.
descriptions.completed:
The #rDirty Treasure Map#k is covered in Green, Red, and White.

Green was removed from the map using the Slime Eraser.
Red was vaporized by the Flint, and the curse of the animal's blood was released using Ayan Mercury's Microphone.
White, after being sprayed with the special Ink, quickly revealed the map.

The map has finally been completed!
